text: dsh-linghun 是面向 DSH web profile 的认知与记忆插件。它向 system prompt 加入可配置的身份、判断纪律和记忆段落，并注册灵魂卡与记忆工具。主要能力包括读写灵魂卡、追加和检索记忆、按需沉淀暖态记忆，以及在回合结束时评估可保留内容并记录对话流水。记忆以 DSH_HOME 下的 Markdown 文件保存，适合希望 agent 保留经验、维护自定义身份并减少重复整理的 DSH 用户；不需要额外账号或 API key。

dsh-linghun adds identity, judgment, and memory prompts to DSH. Its tools update a soul card, save and retrieve memories, and consolidate them as local Markdown. It can assess useful content at turn end and record a journal. No extra account or API key is required.
想让 DSH agent 在不同会话之间记住重要事实和经验。
能不能把对话里值得保留的内容自动整理成长期记忆？
我希望 agent 可以读取和更新自己的身份卡。
让 DSH agent 在回答时带上可配置的判断纪律和身份提示。
I want my DSH agent to retain useful facts across sessions.
Can the agent save important conversation details automatically?
I need an editable identity card and persistent memory for a DSH agent.
dsh-linghun 的功能「灵魂卡读写」：用户可通过 soul_read 查看当前身份与判断提示，并通过 soul_update 更新灵魂卡内容；内容写入 DSH_HOME 下的 linghun/identity.md。
dsh-linghun 的功能「跨会话记忆」：memory_append 将结构化 event、fact 或 rule 条目写入暖态记忆；memory_read 提供读取能力，记忆以本地文件保存。
dsh-linghun 的功能「记忆沉淀与投影」：用户可调用 memory_consolidate 归档暖态记忆，也可使用 memory_project 将记忆整理为主题本体。
dsh-linghun 的功能「回合结束记忆评估」：插件监听 turn/end，将对话流水追加记录，并可评估本轮是否有值得保留的内容后写入记忆。
I want to keep a searchable journal of what my DSH agent and I discussed.

dsh-linghun README · Linghun (灵魂) — End the Agent's Endless Planning：> Your DeepSeek agent plans and plans, then does nothing. A page of strategy, zero execution.
> The model isn't weak — it's missing a **closer**. Linghun supplies it.

**Linghun** gives DeepSeek Harness agents a *closing-mind* identity, boundary-judgment discipline,
and a hippocampus-style memory loop — every judgment has a source, every decision gets closed,
and experience keeps flowing back into the next round. Endless planning is cut off by mechanism.
section: Linghun (灵魂) — End the Agent's Endless Planning

dsh-linghun README · Linghun (灵魂) — End the Agent's Endless Planning：- **The Closer (收口者)**: the LLM supplies intuition and candidate answers; the agent evaluates,
  filters, and closes — thinking, judging, and deciding happen on the agent's side. **Planning must land.**
- **Boundary discipline**: never force-precision on fuzzy concepts, never fake consistency on
  paradoxes, verify before asserting, never fabricate, and watch for "raise-the-cost-of-refusal" wording.
- **Cognition loop**: judgment has a source, feedback has attribution, improvement keeps its chain.
- **Hippocampus (three-layer memory)**: warm buffer for recent facts → consolidation into
  episodic archive (same-day appends, never overwrites) → cold summary injected. The injection
  slot carries only high-frequency abstract experience (cold summary/rules); warm recent facts
  are read on demand via `memory_read` — injection bandwidth for abstraction, details on query.
- **Chronological ledger (序时账)**: `journal_read` returns the raw conversation ledger, archived
  by day — trace exactly what was said when, complementing the forgetful warm layer.
- **Confidence-weighted forgetting**: every entry carries a confidence t

text:
dsh-linghun README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-linghun
```

Requires DSH >= 0.1.0-rc.7 (< 0.2.0), Node.js >= 20.18.

dsh-linghun README · Write your own soul card (persona)：On first run, the plugin drops a default soul card at `$DSH_HOME/linghun/identity.md`.
**Edit that file and you are writing your own persona** — changes take effect immediately, no restart needed:

```bash
$EDITOR $DSH_HOME/linghun/identity.md
```

```markdown

dsh-linghun README · My Soul Card：My name is Blue.
Personality: cautious, direct.
Communication style: short sentences, conclusion first.
Other: (anything you want; leave it out if nothing)
```

Just four fields — name, personality, communication style, and everything else goes into `Other`.
Identity anchors, conduct, and growth are added automatically by the plugin — **you don't write them**.

dsh-linghun README · My Soul Card：Precedence: `identity.md` file > settings content > built-in default card (falls back when the file is
missing or blank). The agent can also edit the card itself via `soul_update`, or you can adjust the soul
name/content in DSH Settings → 灵魂 (Linghun).

dsh-linghun README · Injection & tools：Prompt sections injected:

- `soul:identity` — soul card (identity anchors: the Closer architecture)
- `soul:judgment` — boundary scan discipline (six boundary classes) + the Closer's judgment role
- `soul:memory` — cold summary (high-frequency abstract experience) + archive index; warm recent is read on demand via `memory_read`

Tools exposed:

dsh-linghun README · Injection & tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_append` | Write a timestamped memory (fact / decision / preference / experience) |
| `memory_read` | Read the hippocampus back (cold summary + warm recent + archive index; recent facts on demand) |
| `memory_consolidate` | Consolidate: warm → `episodic/<date>.md`, merge cold summary |
| `soul_read` | Read your own soul card (who I am, my boundaries, my discipline) |
| `soul_update` | Update your own soul card (fold stable traits into identity) |
| `journal_read` | Read the chronological ledger (raw conversation history, archived by day) |

dsh-linghun README · Injection & tools：Memory lives in plain Markdown under `$DSH_HOME/linghun/memory/` — readable, searchable, git-friendly.
The soul card is at `$DSH_HOME/linghun/identity.md` — also plain Markdown. Your persona is yours; edit it however you like.

dsh-linghun README · Injection & tools：> **Injection layering (v0.4.4)**: warm recent memory is NOT injected by default
> (`linghun.memory.injectWarm` defaults to `false`) — injection bandwidth is reserved for
> high-frequency abstract experience; recent details are read on demand via `memory_read`.
> Set `injectWarm: true` for special cases (empty cold store, needing recent context inline).

dsh-linghun README · Engineering guardrails (v0.2)：- **End-of-turn assessment** — on every `turn/end`, the plugin asks the model once whether the turn produced anything worth keeping (`fact` / `decision` / `preference` / `experience`). Worthwhile entries are appended to warm memory automatically; `SKIP` is emitted when nothing qualifies. This no longer depends on the model remembering to call `memory_append` on its own.
- **Threshold auto-consolidation** — when warm memory reaches `maxBytes × triggerRatio`, the plugin archives warm → `episodic/<date>.md` and merges the cold summary **before** writing the new entry. The model never hits a full-memory error and never has to schedule consolidation itself.

dsh-linghun README · Engineering guardrails (v0.2)：Both can be tuned under the `linghun.memory.assessment` / `linghun.memory.autoConsolidate` settings (each with an `enabled` switch), e.g. through `cordis.patch.yml`.

dsh-linghun README · Roadmap：- **v0.1.0** (done): identity + judgment + hippocampus
- **v0.2.0** (done): engineering memory guardrails — end-of-turn assessment + threshold auto-consolidation
- **v0.3.0** (done): miss-verification discipline — "candidate not hit" in material ≠ memory has none; verify cold storage for factual queries; converge by question type for identity/background
- **v0.3.3** (released, then revised in v0.3.4): Censor (verifier verification discipline) — shipped as a
  supervision mechanism (3 drift classes + 4-step admonition + CONFIRMED taming). Benchmarked against a
  9-case gold standard: **criterion-widening regex 100% false positives, drift-widening 43% false
  positives, uniform miss-kills 0 detected** — judgment does not drift, so the monitor mechanism was
  removed. The drift signals and miss-kill anchors moved into the judgment domain ontology
- **v0.3.4** (current): the Censor reverts to a **one-line judgment identity role** inside
  `soul:judgment` — no separate section, no `yanguan_audit` / `yanguan_review` tools, no CONFIRMED table.
  Reliability rests on domain rules (R-J series), not on a supervision layer
- **v0.4.0**: LLM-distilled cold storage
